label: Sufficient reason
resolution: Sufficient reason is read in the bare sense (DEF-PSR-STRENGTH-REASON) in every coverage formulation. The necessitating sense (DEF-PSR-REASON-NECESSITATING) appears only as the separately listed hypothesis Necessitating. The results never pass from one to the other: the collapse core lists Necessitating as a member, and the model ground true satisfies the other members without it. Which sense a source or a worldview intends is not decided here.
